# Phrasely

> A personal vocabulary tool for collecting English phrases from real life, with AI-powered curation and a word cloud that grows as you learn.

Production: https://getphrasely.com

## What it does

Phrasely helps you build a personal collection of English phrases you encounter in real life — books, articles, conversations. When you add a raw phrase, the AI curates it: it identifies the headword (the dictionary form), adds a usage note, and finds the Merriam-Webster link. Your collection is visualised as a word cloud (bubble) where words you revisit most appear largest.

## Key concepts

- **Phrase**: a sentence or fragment captured from real life, associated with one or more headwords
- **Headword**: the dictionary form of the key word or expression in the phrase (e.g. "unfettered", "in the groove")
- **Curate**: AI-powered enrichment — takes a raw phrase and returns headword, note, and source URL
- **Bubble**: word cloud visualisation of your headwords, sized by how often you revisit them (stored in localStorage)

## Auth

Sign in via magic link — no passwords required.

## Data model

```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "phrase": "The legislation was unfettered by constitutional constraints.",
  "headwords": ["unfettered"],
  "source_urls": ["https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/unfettered"],
  "note": "Used to describe something free from restriction or control.",
  "created_at": "2026-06-05T00:00:00Z",
  "updated_at": "2026-06-05T00:00:00Z"
}
```
